display_bin_convention.rule: Display bin b contains composite values in [b-0.5,b+0.5); exact half-point boundaries enter the higher bin.
display_bin_convention.scope: Descriptive integer-bin figures and summaries only. Threshold inference uses the continuous unbinned composite.

submitted_baseline.sampling_frame: Constructed benchmark balanced on a preliminary single-judge rubric score, then rescored for analysis by a four-judge ensemble
submitted_baseline.preliminary_sampling_score: o4-mini using the same six-dimension rubric

post_hoc_excluded_model.reason_for_scope_note: The run covered only the earlier prompt frame and was excluded before the final panel analysis in a post hoc decision without a prespecified eligibility rule. Performance was not a documented exclusion criterion, so reported claims are limited to the 21-model panel.

method.outcome: mean pass_rate over all panel generations of the prompt (build_combined_df; a missing pass_rate is coded 0 by load_scored_model)
method.regressor: mean kappa_cyclomatic over the panel generations with computable output CC
method.iv_covariance: linearmodels IV2SLS cov_type='robust' (heteroskedasticity-robust, no small-sample correction)
method.first_stage_wald: linearmodels first_stage.diagnostics f.stat under the robust covariance: Wald chi2(k), not divided by k

subsample_overidentification.rng: numpy.random.RandomState(seed); one stream over sizes in the listed order; rng.choice(N, n, replace=False) per draw over the prompt frame sorted by prompt_id

rows.note: Every without-replacement draw of size N is a permutation of the full sample, and J is permutation invariant.

principal_components.decomposition: SVD of column-centred, unstandardised rubric dimensions
principal_components.orientation: each component signed so its branching loading is nonnegative

prompt_mean_sensitivity.definition: pass_rate and kappa_cyclomatic both averaged over only the generations with computable output CC (not the paper definition)

method.regime_means: Reported regime means are raw summaries at each selected threshold, matching the manuscript's task-type sensitivity.
method.source_controlled_search: Matches src/rebuttal/09_threshold_with_task_type.py: the pooled null and both regime regressions include the composite and source-frame dummy. The split alternative therefore permits the source coefficient to differ by regime.

source_standardized_to_overall_weights.caution: The retained-earlier frame has limited support above 13.75, so this standardization is an overlap diagnostic rather than a population estimate.

matched_five_model.outcome: raw unit-test harness (extension generations were not saved, so not audited)

fixed_version_three_model_check.analysis_frame: 150 midrange anchors plus 365 audit-clean extension prompts

high_complexity_extension.limitation: Only 14 audit-clean additions are above display bin 16, so the extreme tail remains underpowered.

language_transfer.scope: Measurement transfer only; no full non-Python execution rerun.

pass_vs_output_cc.sem: pandas sem of generation rows (ddof=1); no adjustment for repeated prompts or models

passing_generation_mapping.definition: Generation-level OLS of raw output CC on the prompt composite over generations with pass_rate == 1 and computable CC. kappa_map.by_bin uses numpy round-half-to-even bins of the composite (reviewed convention).
passing_generation_mapping.by_display_bin_rule: half-open: bin b holds composites in [b-0.5, b+0.5)

library_diagnostic.outcome: prompt-level mean pass_rate over the analyzed models
library_diagnostic.tag_definition: case-insensitive whole-word match of prompt text against LIBRARY_TERMS (scripts/regenerate_mechanism_diagnostic.py)
library_diagnostic.test_feature_definition: prompt_features() on stage_d_prompts.jsonl, whose unit_tests are a JSON string: count = occurrences of 'assert', length = raw string length
library_diagnostic.source_pool_definition: 1 if construction frame is later_candidate (selection_source stage_d_candidate), else 0
library_diagnostic.reviewed_value_note: The reviewed n=459 estimate (-0.0501, SE 0.0978, p 0.608) used the 24-bin equal-support frame (benchmark plus OpenCodeInstruct mined-pool prompts; source pool = mined vs benchmark), which is not part of these inputs; see scripts/regenerate_mechanism_diagnostic.py.

output_cc_regression_diagnostics.unit: prompt-level means across model generations with computable output cyclomatic complexity
output_cc_regression_diagnostics.interpretation: The 2SLS coefficient is diagnostic only because the full instrument set fails overidentification.

mechanism_diagnostic.interpretation: The scoped diagnostic provides no support for a library/framework explanation, while other source-composition mechanisms remain possible.

method.interpretation: Model-specific breakpoint estimates are conditional on the constructed benchmark frame, prompt index, generation settings, and unit-test protocol.
method.regime_means: Raw descriptive means at each selected threshold; the sup-Wald test is not a separate test of their difference.

model_specific_source_frame.selection_rule: All and only models whose locked unadjusted original-benchmark fit has a negative raw above-minus-below regime contrast.
